outline: 教導學生自然纖維，再生纖維，半合成纖，一般合成纖維,如聚酯,尼龍,亞克力,等 及特殊合成纖維，其製備,抽絲,結構,化性,物性,用途等
schedule:
1. Cotton(2 weeks)
2. Jute
3. Wool(2 weeks)
4. Silk
5. Acetate Fiber
6. Rayon
Mid-term Exam
7. PET, PBT(2 weeks)
8. Nylons(2 weeks)
9. PAN, Carbon Fiber(2 weeks)
10. Polyolefin Fibers
11.PVA Fiber
12. Elastomeric Fibers
13. Aramide Fibers
14. PBI, LC Fibers, Polyimde Fibers, PPS
15. Glass Fibers, Ceramic Fibers, Optical Fibers(If Time Available)
Final Exam
assessment:
Term Performance Including Attendance(30%)
Mid-term Exam(30%)
Final Exam(40%)
materials:
